content: Mûka anacinjamwo nk’oku anali ambwîzire, anyîmanza. Okubundi nanaciyumva olyâla wakâg’indesa.
Anacimbwîra, erhi: «Wâni mwene omuntu, nkola nakurhuma emwa bene Israheli, emw’olubaga lw’abagoma, abagoma bangomeraga. Bône na bîshe bangomire kuhika oku lusiku lw’ene.
Emwa abôla bâna bagwêrhe irhwe lizibu n’omurhima gudundagwîre, yo nkurhumire, nti ogend’ibambwîrira, erhi: Ntyâla kwo adesire Nyakasane Nyamubâho!
Bakuyumve nîsi erhi babè barhakuyumvirhi, -bulya ebà nyumpa ya bagoma-, bâmanya oku habà omulêbi ekarhî kâbo.

Ci woyo, mwene omuntu, orhabayôbohaga, orhanayôbohaga ebinwa byâbo, bulya oli ekarhî kâbo nka ôli ekâgarhî k’emishûgi na bulya otamîre oku mahiri-joka. Orhayôbohaga ebinwa byâbo orhanabayôbohaga bône, bulya liri iburha lya bagoma.
Obabwîre ebinwa byâni, babiyumve nîsi erhi babè barhabiyumvirhi, bulya libà iburha lya bâgoma.
Ci woyo, mwene omuntu, yumva oku nakubwîra: orhabâga mugoma aka eyôla nyumpa y’abagoma; obumbûle akanwa onalye ngasi ebi nakanakuhà».
Nanacilolêreza: nabona okuboko kulambulîrwe emunda ndi kunafumbasire ecitabu cizinge.
Anacicibungûlira embere zâni: càli ciyandike olunda n’olundi; càli ciyandikekwo: «Ndûlù, njamu, mirenge!»

footnotes.text: 2, 1 Mwene omuntu: kuli kulonza okuderha «muntu». Olo luli luderho lurharhenga omu kanwa ka Yehezekiyeli, alukolêsize kal’igana. Embere z’irenge lya Nyakasane, lirya lirhankayêgerwa buzira kugeramwo omusisi (Eze 1, 28), Yehezekiyeli ali mugalugalu, mwene omuntu (Eze 2, 1.3.6.8); ciru omu bunyi bwâge arhankahashiyimanga embere z’irenge lya Nyakasane.
